resources.string: Sends your vehicles\' state from Drivelog to your Home Assistant: their latest values, where they are parked and the services coming up. Drivelog sends it whenever something changes, at most once a minute; it goes only to the address below.\n\nIn Home Assistant, paste the configuration below into configuration.yaml and restart: the sensors appear by themselves.
Webhook id (hard to guess: whoever knows it can send to it)
Values: odometer, fuel, range, 12 V battery, doors, tyres
Where each vehicle is parked (its location)
Nothing from Drivelog yet: use "Send now", or it comes with the next change (a trip, a reading, a service entry).
Home Assistant answers OK even when it drops the data (another webhook id, a local-only webhook reached from outside): if the sensors stay empty, see Settings → System → Logs in Home Assistant.
